name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Students can view only their enrolled timetable
description: Verifies the timetable view is scoped to the authenticated student's active course enrollments.
steps: Sign in as a Student with one active course enrollment
expected: Only timetable entries for courses in the student's active enrollments are shown.

name: Lecturer creates and removes a class timetable entry
description: Verifies a lecturer can create a valid weekly class schedule and remove their own entry.
steps: Choose an existing course, day, valid start and end times, and venue
expected: The entry appears under the selected day, remains after refresh, and is removed only after confirmation.

name: Academic administration is read-only for students
description: Verifies a student cannot create or delete institutional structure.
steps: Verify there are no create or delete controls
expected: Student access remains read-only and API writes are denied.

name: Invalid timetable values and duplicate student enrollment are rejected
description: Verifies invalid time ranges and duplicate enrollment requests cannot create records.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and submit a timetable entry whose end time is before its start time
Sign in as an Administrator and attempt to enroll the same student into the same course twice
expected: Invalid time ranges and duplicate enrollments are rejected without creating duplicate records.
